name: Explicit Lighting Geometry Prompting
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Encode light direction + color temperature + softness explicitly (`45-degree warm amber key from right, soft cool sky fill on left, crisp hair rim`) instead of generic `good lighting`.

name: Surface Micro-Roughness Prompting
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Name physically descriptive finish pairings (`brushed anodized titanium, damp irregular cobbles, raw coarse linen, subtle patina brass`) to prevent plastic uniform surfaces.

name: Three-Plane Depth Prompt Architecture
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Define Foreground anchor (`softly defocused raindrop leaves`), Midground subject (`sharp illuminated traveler`), and Background horizon (`mist-veiled valley peaks`) in spatial order.

name: Viewer-Relative Axis Precision
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Specify exact viewer elevation, lens focal length, and gaze direction (`eye-level 50mm lens, subject angled 3/4 left looking right past camera`) so subjects face intended targets.

name: Controlled Cinema Color Palettes
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Anchor scenes around 1 dominant mood hue (`deep slate charcoal`), 1 warm practical accent (`amber tungsten`), and restrained neutral midtones rather than clashing rainbow neon clutter.

name: Restrained Micro-Expression Prompting
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Replace exaggerated melodrama tokens with subtle physical cues (`relaxed brow, thoughtful parted lips, calm steady gaze, faint crease around eyes`) for photographic humanity.

name: Temporal Velocity & Ease Prompting
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: State explicit motion tempo (`unhurried steady glide`, `gradual deceleration into stillness`, `gentle breeze sway`) so diffusion video stays coherent and free of erratic jitter.

name: Single-Focus Subject Decoupling
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Keep subject descriptors grouped cleanly with spatial separation (`tall knight on left in weathered iron; smalllantern boy on right in ochre wool`) to minimize attribute bleeding.

name: Frame Geometry & Crop Language
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Match shot scale terms cleanly to aspect (`full-bleed horizontal widescreen vista, generous sky headroom` vs `medium close-up portrait framing shoulders upward`).

name: Unified Atmospheric Weather Cues
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Propagate weather into every detail: wind bends grass and hair in one coherent direction; rain wets shoulders, hair strands, and pavement reflections consistently.

name: Clean Realism vs Illustration Locking
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Never mix contradictory render mediums (`photorealistic raw dslr` alongside `flat 2d cel vector`) unless intentionally bridged; keep medium tokens coherent end-to-end.

name: Clean Crowd Layering Syntax
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Anchor sharp focus explicitly on one central subject while keeping surrounding passersby `softly blurred in natural motion across deeper background distance`.

name: Optical Reflection & Glass Clarity
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Specify exact mirror surfaces (`still dark alpine lake reflecting dawn ridges, rain-beaded café pane reflecting glowing warm interior`) for crisp optical plausibility.

name: Scale Anchor Prompt Technique
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Include recognizable human-scale cues (`tiny silhouetted hiker on granite ledge, miniature streetlamp pool, birds banking past spire`) so colossal environments read immediately.

name: Structured Wardrobe Ordering
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Describe clothing inner-to-outer and top-to-bottom (`charcoal knit turtleneck beneath oversized wet slate trench coat, leather belt, worn boots`) so garments layer believably.

name: Automotive Perspective Grounding
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Pair clean perspective view (`front three-quarter low angle`) with crisp surface spec (`matte satin slate body, amber DRL blades, tire sidewall planted cleanly in contact shadow`).

name: Specific Flora & Terrain Naming
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Replace generic `nature/trees` with specific forms (`windswept Scots pine, wet moss-draped basalt boulders, frosty alpine tussock grass`) for rich organic realism.

name: Grounded Prop Contact Physics
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Describe exact hand-object contact (`left hand gripping wooden umbrella handle calmly at shoulder height, rainwater beading down translucent canopy`) cleanly.

name: Multi-Shot Sequence Prompt Harmony
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Carry color palette, light key angle, costume, and weather descriptors consistently across consecutive prompt shots (`Shot 1 wide -> Shot 2 OTS -> Shot 3 tight CU`).

name: Image-to-Video Anchor Fidelity
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: When writing Wan VACE motion prompts anchored on a keyframe image, reinforce keyframe lighting and subject traits briefly while dedicating most tokens to clear, smooth motion vectors.

name: Prompt Token Ablation Debugging
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Fix muddy or overbaked diffusion prompts by stripping redundant synonyms (`ultra 8k masterpiece hyperrealistic unreal engine`), lowering conflicting weights, and restoring clean concrete nouns.

name: Prompt-to-Sampler Parameter Pairing
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Align ComfyUI Wan 2.1 + CausVid parameters with prompt dynamics: keep `cfg=1.1–1.5`, `steps=6`, `shift=5.5–6.0`, and clean `640×368 -> 720p` scaling for crisp artifact-free cinema.
